dependency_map.affected domains: the change record of the child call; every derived fact reads only the domains named in its dependency: edge (u,v) -> max(D_v), min(D_u); rule-2 key (e,c) -> singles; EF op -> newly full cycles of its engine; value interval -> producer bounds and consumer minima; pair (u,v) -> min/max(A_v)
dependency_map.branch / sibling / resume: states are immutable after construction; a child builds a NEW state (copy-on-write of D, A, singles, contrib); siblings and later resumptions read the unchanged parent; DFS backtracking restores by reference, no undo log
dependency_map.fixed context: fixed times/addresses/base usage are Propagation constants (R0's own)
dependency_map.incumbent-sensitive data: only prune's `best`; it is an argument, never cached; PB certificates are emitted by the unchanged comparison
dependency_map.partial times -> fixed lifetimes -> addr: the time leaf's TimeState (with its cached peak) is reused by every address-phase prune of that leaf; address states are rebuilt from the leaf's pairs tuple (PairInfo built once per leaf, charged to the address root)
dependency_map.program / query / epoch: a Propagation is built per query domain (program, window, caps, incumbent epoch); all masks and states belong to it and die with the query; nothing is shared across Propagations or compilations
dependency_map.roots: time root: R0's own times_fixpoint then singles from its output; address root: emulation with every pair dirty (identical to R0's first sweep)

reconciliation: sum(exclusive) + untimed remainder = timed wall on every program (DIAGNOSIS.json 'reconciliation' = 1.0000); timer inflation over unprofiled T0 1.01-1.52
stage: M0 cost-ownership map (exclusive timers; nested calls charged once)

timer_components.bounds_live: compulsory_peak + _static_max (one component with product_bound: live/product bounds)
timer_components.certificates: PropagationStats.emit (charged here, not to the emitting rule)
timer_components.untimed_remainder: everything else (search loop, catalog, acceptor, bootstrap)
